title: Bifrost Spec (ISA-88 two-layer)
description: Protocol-independent recipe/spec contract describing BOTH ISA-88 layers: a general recipe (product-domain, equipment-independent, carrying setpoint intents) and a master recipe (a general recipe bound to a site's equipment, carrying concrete setpoints addressed to equipment members). A document is exactly one of the two. Language-neutral — any consumer can validate a spec document against this schema without depending on Bifrost code.

generalSpec.description: ISA-88 general recipe: product-domain, equipment-independent spec carrying equipment-independent setpoint intents.

version.description: SemVer of this spec, serialized as a major.minor.patch string.

productDomain.description: The product domain this general recipe applies to (equipment-independent).

setpointIntents.description: Equipment-independent setpoint intents, keyed by logical name.

masterSpec.description: ISA-88 master recipe: a general recipe bound to a specific site's equipment, carrying concrete setpoints addressed to equipment members.

version.description: SemVer of this spec, serialized as a major.minor.patch string.

site.description: The site whose equipment this master recipe is bound to.

equipmentRef.description: Registry-key id of the equipment definition this master recipe binds.

equipmentVersion.description: SemVer of the bound equipment definition, serialized as a major.minor.patch string.

setpoints.description: Concrete setpoints, each addressed to an equipment member by name.

setpointIntent.description: An equipment-independent setpoint intent: logical key + type + numeric value.

setpoint.description: A concrete setpoint addressed to an equipment member: member name + type + numeric value.

member.description: Equipment member name this setpoint addresses.
